system.description:
• Effect: Your patron's old magic runs truer in you: you're hardier than your spindly d6 Hit Die suggests. Gain a permanent +1 bonus to maximum HP per Witch level: in effect a d8 Hit Die.
  • 8th: +2 maximum HP per Witch level instead: in effect a d10 Hit Die. Beyond 10th level the Vigour adds +1 a level, so you gain 3 HP a level plus your Constitution modifier, as a d10 class does.
